waivers.reason: The fix ships in postcss 8.5.12, but next 15.5.x pins postcss at exactly 8.4.31 (re-checked at next 15.5.24, the newest stable; 15.6.0 is canary-only) and an end-user install resolves next's own pin, so neither a direct dependency nor a workspace override reaches it; postcss runs only at build time, and the shipped dashboard is pre-built. Bump next once it requires a patched postcss.
